The '''[[Galactic Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]] Communications Agency''' was one of the General Ministry's small task oriented agencies. Unfortunately, it informed over 250,000 worlds in the Outer Rim would have to go without the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] for another year due to budget cuts.
